description: Source code for Elasticsearch vector store node implementation, including methods for upsert, delete, and initialization, integrating with Langchain and Elasticsearch client.

classes.name: Elasticsearch_VectorStores
classes.description: Implements an Elasticsearch-based vector store node with methods for upsert, delete, and initialization, supporting similarity search and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods
methods.description: Contains methods for upserting documents into Elasticsearch and deleting documents by IDs, handling credential and client setup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the vector store, sets up similarity search, and returns either a retriever or vector store based on configuration.
